summary: Offline scoped Active Directory inventory and evidence-linked candidate privilege-path analysis.
limitations: Only accepts an approved, opaque, local JSON export; does not collect from AD, hosts, LDAP, or Kerberos.
Observed relationships and candidate paths do not prove the privilege can be exercised or that exploitation is possible.
Missing paths and incomplete collection never establish environmental absence or safety; host installation and live integration are unverified.

demo.description: Analyze a synthetic two-forest AD graph with a protected identity, trust boundary, and partial host collection.
